title: Electronics — Chapter 3: Introducing PCB Project Stakeholders

questions.question: When should you examine design constraints, according to Chapter 3?
options: Only after the first fab disposition email arrives.
At the start of the project, before ever starting the layout.
After silk-screen fonts are locked for marketing photos.
Never — constraints slow automation and Old Bob–speed delivery.
questions.explanation: Examine all the constraints at the start of a design project before

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: It is important to note here that a project manager, along with the team of stakeholders, have already set many of the design and manufacturing goals for the PCB, which are translated into the term, “constraints,” by the time the project has moved to the layout phase.

questions.question: What does the parts list influence beyond part numbers?
options: Only the color of the soldermask legend ink.
Availability, size, shape, and performance of the design.
Whether ITAR text appears on the purchase order footer.
The public review score used to pick EMS suppliers.
questions.explanation: what goes into a parts list will influence

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Most of the assembly process relies on auditing these listed parts for pricing, availability and lead time.

questions.question: Why contact a fab supplier about size/shape before layout?
options: Raw materials are stocked in sheet form; confirm the outline fits available material.
Fabs only cut boards from liquid copper poured at the dock.
Sheet stock is irrelevant once defaults route at one mil.
Outline size is chosen randomly after Gerbers are emailed.
questions.explanation: Raw materials for PCB fabrication are stocked in sheet form

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFRaw materials for PCB fabrication are stocked in sheet form by the supplier.

questions.question: Testability planning in this chapter includes asking about:
options: Whether bed-of-nails or functional test (etc.) will be used on the assemblies.
Only whether the fab offers overnight panel shipment with no test plan.
Whether star ratings exceed 4.2 on Quickie-Cheapo directories.
Whether Otto can perform ICT using only the HR body scanner.
questions.explanation: How the assemblies will be tested. Bed-of-nails or functional test

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: How the assemblies will be tested. Bed-of-nails or functional test, etc.

questions.question: “All customer needs will be met in the end if…”
options: You pick the cheapest fab on star ratings every time.
All stakeholder needs are met before and during the project.
You disable DFM checks to protect schedule optimism.
You sole-source every bare board without visiting the facility.
questions.explanation: if all stakeholder needs are met before and during the project

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: All customer needs will be met in the end if all stakeholder needs are met before and during the project.

questions.question: Placement of a single design can influence:
options: Only the PDF page count of the assembly drawing notes.
Thousands of parts and operations downstream in manufacturing.
Nothing once the schematic symbol library is approved.
Only the color of the shipping box used by the EMS.
questions.explanation: how a single design placement influences thousands of parts

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Bed-of-nails or functional test, etc. FFAcknowledge that what goes into a parts list will influence availability, size, shape, and performance.

reference.excerpt: Scrutinize your process. Things will go wrong

questions.question: SpaceX sourcing collaboration maps most closely to which Chapter 3 idea?
options: Ignore internal stakeholders; only the fab star rating matters.
Work across disciplines so supplier capability and design constraints stay aligned.
Let engineering place POs with no commercial or process input.
Treat the BOM as optional until after NPI scrap is accepted.
questions.explanation: Communication with all stakeholders is critical

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Communication with all stakeholders is critical
reference.lecture: Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and with internal stakeholders
